name: typesearch · News search API
description: News search by topic: across an index of news outlets, on a live site, or for articles similar to a given one, judged by a calibrated relevance model. Compatible endpoints for Perplexity (/compat/perplexity), Exa (/compat/exa) and Tako (/compat/tako): see the migration guides at https://typesearch.ai/docs. For AI agents, a remote MCP server at /mcp (Streamable HTTP; tools search_news, get_contents, find_similar and create_chart) with the same key and prices. Custom indexes (/v1/indexes): search your own list of URLs, sitemap or feed with the same relevance model, passing `index` to /v1/search or search_news. Charts (/v1/charts): ask in plain words and get an embeddable chart card that picks the right chart, the key figures and a title that states the finding; or send your own data. Pricing, per 1,000 requests: ultra $1.00, fast $1.40, normal $2.20, deep $5.60; similar $2.20 ($4.60 in deep mode); live site search $2.40. Contents, per 1,000 pages: $0.20, or $0.40 with a query. Custom indexes: $2.00 per 1,000 URLs per month, billed daily; searches over them cost their mode. Charts: from a query, its search (the mode, per query) plus $0.50 per 1,000 charts; from your own data, $0.30 per 1,000; embeds and images are free. Each query in a multi-query request is billed as one search of its mode; cached results and failed requests are free. The same list, machine-readable, is in `x-pricing`.
